description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
After performing Basic Attack Stage 3 or Heavy Attack Pruning, hold Normal Attack Button to continuously strike the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Basic Attack Stage 4 is automatically followed by Basic Attack Stage 5.

Heavy Attack - Pruning

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.
Setelah melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3 atau Heavy Attack Pruning, tahan tombol Normal Attack untuk terus menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Basic Attack Tahap 4 otomatis dilanjutkan dengan Basic Attack Tahap 5.

Heavy Attack - Pruning

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en:
Crimson Blossom

Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG), then enter Blossom Mode.
This attack can be performed in mid-air.

Blossom Mode

- Unable to move while suspended on vines.
- Basic Attack and Heavy Attack Pruning are replaced by Basic Attack Vining Waltz: chain together 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- When performing Vining Waltz Stage 3, hold Normal Attack Button to cast Blazing Waltz that deals Havoc DMG before automatically performing Vining Waltz Stage 4.
- Dodge Counter is replaced by Dodge Counter Atonement. Tap Normal Attack Button right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill is replaced by Resonance Skill Floral Ravage. Casting Floral Ravage deals Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill Floral Ravage can be cast in mid-air.
- Blossom Mode ends after casting Resonance Skill Floral Ravage.
- Blossom Mode ends after using the Levitator.
- Jump is replaced with Basic Attack Vining Ronde. Use Jump to attack the target at the cost of STA, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG). This ends the Blossom Mode.
- Using Basic Attack Vining Waltz and Basic Attack Blazing Waltz in mid-air consumes STA.
- Casting Resonance Skill Floral Ravage doesn't restore STA.
- Consume STA continuously to stay suspended on the vines.
description.id:
Crimson Blossom

Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG), lalu memasuki Blossom Mode.
Serangan ini dapat dilakukan di udara.

Blossom Mode

- Tidak dapat bergerak saat menggantung pada sulur.
- Basic Attack dan Heavy Attack Pruning digantikan oleh Basic Attack Vining Waltz: merangkai 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
- Saat melakukan Vining Waltz Tahap 3, tahan tombol Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Blazing Waltz yang memberikan Havoc DMG sebelum otomatis melakukan Vining Waltz Tahap 4.
- Dodge Counter digantikan oleh Dodge Counter Atonement. Ketuk tombol Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Floral Ravage. Melancarkan Floral Ravage memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill Floral Ravage dapat dilancarkan di udara.
- Blossom Mode berakhir setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Floral Ravage.
- Blossom Mode berakhir setelah menggunakan Levitator.
- Jump digantikan oleh Basic Attack Vining Ronde. Gunakan Jump untuk menyerang target dengan biaya STA, memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG). Ini mengakhiri Blossom Mode.
- Menggunakan Basic Attack Vining Waltz dan Basic Attack Blazing Waltz di udara mengonsumsi STA.
- Melancarkan Resonance Skill Floral Ravage tidak memulihkan STA.
- Terus mengonsumsi STA untuk tetap menggantung pada sulur.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Hitting a target with Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement , Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, and Resonance Skill Floral Ravage consumes Crimson Pistils. The Energy Regen Multiplier of this attack is increased by 150%.
Consuming 10 Crimson Pistils recovers 4 Concerto Energy and obtains 1 Crimson Bud(s). Each bud lasts for 15s, stacking up to 10 times.

Forte Circuit: Ephemeral

When Concerto Energy is fully recovered, and Ephemeral is not on Cooldown, Resonance Skill is replaced with Ephemeral.
Casting Ephemeral consumes 70 Concerto Energy and deals Havoc DMG to the targets. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Camellya enters Budding Mode after casting Ephemeral.
This can be cast in mid-air.

Budding Mode

- Sweet Dream: Increase the DMG Multiplier of Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement, Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, and Resonance Skill Floral Ravage by 50%.
- Casting Ephemeral consumes all Crimson Buds. Each Crimson Bud consumed additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of Sweet Dream by 5%, up to 50%.
- When in Budding Mode, Camellya cannot gain Crimson Buds.
- When in Budding Mode, the Energy Regen Multiplier of Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement, Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, and Resonance Skill Floral Ravage is reduced to 0%.
- Budding Mode ends when Camellya is switched off the field.
- Budding Mode ends when all Crimson Pistils are consumed.

Crimson Pistil

Camellya can hold up to 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Casting Intro Skill Everblooming recovers 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Activating Forte Circuit's Ephemeral recovers 100 Crimson Pistils.
description.id:
Mengenai target dengan Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement, Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, dan Resonance Skill Floral Ravage mengonsumsi Crimson Pistils. Pengali Energy Regen serangan ini meningkat sebesar 150%.
Mengonsumsi 10 Crimson Pistils memulihkan 4 Concerto Energy dan memberikan 1 Crimson Bud. Setiap bud berlangsung selama 15 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 10 kali.

Forte Circuit: Ephemeral

Saat Concerto Energy pulih sepenuhnya dan Ephemeral tidak dalam Cooldown, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Ephemeral.
Melancarkan Ephemeral mengonsumsi 70 Concerto Energy dan memberikan Havoc DMG kepada target. Damage ini dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Camellya memasuki Budding Mode setelah melancarkan Ephemeral.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Budding Mode

- Sweet Dream: Meningkatkan Pengali DMG Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement, Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, dan Resonance Skill Floral Ravage sebesar 50%.
- Melancarkan Ephemeral mengonsumsi seluruh Crimson Bud. Setiap Crimson Bud yang dikonsumsi juga meningkatkan Pengali DMG Sweet Dream sebesar 5%, hingga 50%.
- Saat dalam Budding Mode, Camellya tidak dapat memperoleh Crimson Bud.
- Saat dalam Budding Mode, Pengali Energy Regen Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement, Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, dan Resonance Skill Floral Ravage berkurang menjadi 0%.
- Budding Mode berakhir saat Camellya diganti keluar dari arena.
- Budding Mode berakhir saat seluruh Crimson Pistils habis dikonsumsi.

Crimson Pistil

Camellya dapat menampung hingga 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill Everblooming memulihkan 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Mengaktifkan Ephemeral milik Forte Circuit memulihkan 100 Crimson Pistils.

sequences.name: Bloom For You Thousand Times Over

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Forte Circuit's Sweet Dream is additionally increased by 150%.
Forte Circuit Perennial: Within 15s after casting Ephemeral, if Concerto Energy is full and Perennial is not on cooldown, Resonance Skill is replaced with Perennial.
Casting Perennial consumes 50 Concerto Energy and recovers 50 Crimson Pistils, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 100% of Ephemeral DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. This skill can be cast once every 25s.
Camellya enters Budding Mode after casting Perennial and removes all Crimson Buds. The bonus DMG Multiplier granted by Forte Circuit's Sweet Dream is increased to 250%.
Immune to interruptions when casting Perennial.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Sweet Dream milik Forte Circuit meningkat tambahan sebesar 150%.
Forte Circuit Perennial: Dalam 15 dtk setelah melancarkan Ephemeral, jika Concerto Energy penuh dan Perennial tidak dalam cooldown, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Perennial.
Melancarkan Perennial mengonsumsi 50 Concerto Energy dan memulihkan 50 Crimson Pistils, memberikan Havoc DMG sebesar 100% DMG Ephemeral, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Skill ini dapat dilancarkan sekali setiap 25 dtk.
Camellya memasuki Budding Mode setelah melancarkan Perennial dan menghapus seluruh Crimson Bud. Bonus Pengali DMG yang diberikan oleh Sweet Dream milik Forte Circuit meningkat menjadi 250%.
Kebal terhadap interupsi saat melancarkan Perennial.
